text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur-Fasa 2) (Pindaan) 2014.

 (2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 18 Julai 2014.

Pindaan perenggan 2

2. Perintah Jalan Persekutuan (Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur–Fasa 2) 2014

[P.U. (A) 1/2014], yang disebut "Perintah ibu" dalam Perintah ini, dipinda dalam

perenggan 2 dengan menggantikan subperenggan (1) dengan subperenggan yang

berikut:

 "(1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Lebuh Raya Pantai Timur–Fasa 2

yang bermula —

(a) dari kilometer 250.620 di koordinat U+88993.651000,

T+245032.711000 Grid Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO)

Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di kilometer 274.457

di koordinat U+111115.179000, T+243110.234000 Grid (RSO)

Geosentrik (GDM 2000), termasuklah Persimpangan Bertingkat

Cheneh dan jalan-jalan sambungannya iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang

23.837 kilometer; dan

(b) dari kilometer 329.387 di koordinat U+158623.184142,

T+251519.143657 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir

di kilometer 433.977 di koordinat U+243442.227735,

T+213048.376897 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000), termasuklah

Persimpangan Bertingkat Paka, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kuala

Dungun, Persimpangan Bertingkat Bukit Besi, Persimpangan

Bertingkat Ajil, Persimpangan Jalan Telemung, Persimpangan

Bertingkat Telemung, Persimpangan Bertingkat Kuala Terengganu

dan jalan-jalan sambungannya iaitu suatu jarak sepanjang 104.590

kilometer,

diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.".

Penggantian peta

3. Perintah ibu dipinda dengan menggantikan peta dalam Jadual dengan peta yang

berikut:

JADUAL

[Subperenggan 2(2)]

PETA LEBUH RAYA PANTAI TIMUR–FASA 2

Dibuat 14 Julai 2014

[KKR.PUU. 110-1/7/3/2 (29); PN(PU2)391/XXVII]

DATUK HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

 Menteri Kerja Raya

[Akan dibentangkan di Dewan Rakyat menurut seksyen 4 Akta Jalan Persekutuan 1959]

".

"

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (EAST COAST EXPRESSWAY–PHASE 2) (AMENDMENT)

ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Terengganu,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (East Coast

Expressway–Phase 2) (Amendment) Order 2014.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 18 July 2014.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (East Coast Expressway–Phase 2) Order 2014

[P.U. (A) 1/2014], which is referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended

in paragraph 2 by substituting for subparagraph (1) the following subparagraph:

"(1) The part of the road known as the East Coast Expressway–Phase 2

commencing—

(a) from kilometre 250.620 at coordinates N+88993.651000,

E+245032.711000 Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 274.457 at coordinates

N+111115.179000, E+243110.234000 (RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000)

Grid, including Cheneh Interchange and its link roads being a

distance of 23.837 kilometres; and

(b) from kilometre 329.387 at coordinates N+158623.184142,

E+251519.143657 RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending

at kilometre 433.977 at coordinates N+243442.227735,

E+213048.376897 RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid, including

Paka Interchange, Kuala Dungun Interchange, Bukit Besi

Interchange, Ajil Interchange, Telemung Road Junction, Telemung

Interchange, Kuala Terengganu Interchange and its link roads

being a distance of 104.590 kilometres,

is declared to be a Federal road.".

Substitution of map

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the map in the Schedule the

following map:

SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(2)]

MAP OF EAST COAST EXPRESSWAY–PHASE 2

Made 14 July 2014

[KKR.PUU. 110-1/7/3/2 (29); PN(PU2)391/XXVII]

DATUK HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF

 Minister of Works

[To be laid before the Dewan Rakyat pursuant to section 4 of the Federal Roads Act 1959]

".

"
